sections.Profile:
Target Pool and Mini Pool , both released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1969, are electro-mechanical pinball machines with billiard themes designed by Ed Krynski and featuring artwork by Art Stenholm. Target Pool is a replay-type machine with 27 standup targets and one pop bumper, while Mini Pool is an add-a-ball version with similar gameplay.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1969
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Pool (Billiards), Original Theme

- Design: Ed Krynski
- Art: Art Stenholm
